name: Amendments by the committee responsible – separate vote
title: REPORT on the proposal for a Council decision amending Decision (EU) 2021/1764 on the Association of the Overseas Countries and Territories with the European Union including relations between the European Union on the one hand, and Greenland and the Kingdom of Denmark on the other
part_text: 1a. In implementing the regional allocation referred to in paragraph 1, priority shall be given to operations that strengthen strategic investments in ports, maritime transport, energy, and digital networks, as well as initiatives that enhance economic security, preparedness, and the integration of OCTs into sustainable regional and global value chains. Such cooperation shall be compatible with the Union's strategic and economic security interests, contribute to the resilience of value chains and shall not create or deepen critical dependencies.
